scope: post-test supplemental baseline: masked MSE plus frozen VGG16 feature L1, bounded dev-only alpha selection
learning_rate_recipe: exact original three-stage recipe: warm100+cosine2e-4 to4e-5 at2000; constant4e-5 to10000; recover to8e-5 at11000; cosine to1e-5 at30000
area_replacement: expand by one pixel in the same quadrant as each inserted visible slit; exact quadrant missing counts; remove five corner pixels from each condition to reach 1638

foreground_quadrant_caliper.role: diagnostic only; total quadrant mask counts are exactly matched

unsupported_images: exclude symmetrically before training; require at least 80 percent of original train and dev images retained; no model outcomes used
training_flip: flip image and its paired masks together to preserve foreground matching
primary_contrast: selected Perceptual Regression1 versus existing MSE Regression1 and FM8, both seeds
support_criterion: user removed minimum-effect threshold: report any positive mean improvement, uncertainty separately; joint improvement means LPIPS decreases and PSNR increases in equal-weight average of the two geometries; always report each geometry and any tradeoff
evaluation: same124 dev images, four frozen matched-mask pairs/image; Regression deterministic output versus FM existing four-sample average; image-paired bootstrap after averaging mask pairs
official_test_access: only after bounded dev selection and both selected checkpoints frozen; reuse unchanged v9 test common-support cache/masks
limitations: added after v9 official-test results were observed; supplemental, not untouched confirmatory evaluation
same trainable CNN and updates; extra frozen ImageNet VGG16 training computation is disclosed
VGG loss and Squeeze LPIPS use different feature networks but are related perceptual objectives
two training seeds; image bootstrap does not cover training-seed population uncertainty
test uses frozen v9 common-support subset3585/3669; fixed FM8 versus Regression1
no automatic additional weights, architectures, seeds or training extensions
candidate_selection: sample uniformly among the 32 eligible candidates with smallest summed normalized core/possible/head count differences; ties shuffled by mask selection seed
annotation_only_design_audit: 39x42 with 2-pixel gaps rejected for insufficient support; 31x53 with 1-pixel gaps at 16px/2% retained 96/128 train-probe and 86/128 dev; 32px/3% retained 124/128 in each; design frozen before any new-model outcomes
feature_reduction: per-image L1 mean over C/H/W at each layer, equal mean of the 3 layers
feature_input: unclipped composed image y + mask*prediction, map to [0,1] and normalize with ImageNet mean/std
calibration: first64 supported training images, pair0, alternating geometry as training; untrained seed0 CNN; feature_scale=masked_MSE/feature_L1; freeze same scale for all alphas/seeds
selection: seed0 final30k EMA, minimum overall dev LPIPS averaged over 4 mask pairs and 2 geometries; exact ties: higher PSNR then lower alpha; report both candidate tradeoffs; no test access during selection
seed1: train selected alpha only from identical seed1 FM/Regression initialization
